remarks:
Nestled on a quiet dead-end street just moments from the shops, restaurants, and conveniences of Warsaw, this charming 4-bedroom 19th century home offers the perfect blend of character, space, and everyday functionality.

Inside, you’ll find flexible living options with a first-floor bedroom that could easily serve as a private home office, guest room, or playroom. The spacious kitchen is conveniently located next to an oversized pantry/laundry room, making meal preparation and household tasks both efficient and organized.

The large living room and formal dining room provide plenty of space for gatherings, entertaining, or simply relaxing at home. With minimal traffic thanks to the peaceful dead-end location, you can enjoy a quieter setting while still being close to everything Warsaw has to offer.

If you’ve been searching for a home with historic charm, generous living space, and a convenient village location, this property is one you won’t want to miss!
